title: Diet filters and label groups
prompt:
Extend mealie-planner (this repository) with diet filters and a shopping list grouped by food label.

- POST /plans accepts rules.diet, a list of "vegetarian", "vegan" and "gluten-free". Food labels come from GET {MEALIE_URL}/api/foods?page=<n>&perPage=<n>, paginated like the recipes, with items [{"id", "name", "label": {"name"} or null}]. A recipe is excluded when any of its ingredients' foods carries a banned label:
  - vegetarian bans Meat and Fish;
  - vegan bans Meat, Fish, Dairy and Egg;
  - gluten-free bans Gluten.
  Food names match case-insensitively; a food that is not in the list has no label. Diet filters combine with the other rules. An unknown diet value is 400.
- GET /plans/:id/shopping-list?groupBy=label returns {"planId", "groups": [{"label", "items": [...]}], "notes"}: the same items as without grouping, each in the group of its food's label ("Other" when there is none), groups sorted by label with "Other" last.
- Everything that works today keeps working.
